messages.content: 你能告訴我2019年在Playstation平台上有多少活躍玩家參與了《決勝時刻：現代戰爭》這款遊戲，然後將其與2020年在PC平台上的活躍玩家人數進行比較嗎？同時，你能提供《決勝時刻：現代戰爭》在2019年Playstation平台上的銷售數字，以及2020年PC平台上的銷售數字嗎？

function.name: video_games_get_player_count
function.description: Retrieves the number of active players for a specified video game and year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

platform.description: The gaming platform (e.g. 'PC', 'Xbox', 'Playstation'). Default is all if not specified.

function.name: video_games_get_sales
function.description: Retrieves the sales figures for a specified video game and year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

platform.description: The gaming platform (e.g. 'PC', 'Xbox', 'Playstation'). Default is all if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user asks:

"Can you tell me how many active players participated in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare on PlayStation platform in 2019, then compare it with the active player count on PC platform in 2020? Also provide sales numbers for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare on PlayStation in 2019 and PC in 2020."

We need two data points each:
1) Active players for COD MW on PS in 2019.
2) Active players for COD MW on PC in 2020.

Also sales figures for same combos.

We have tool "video_games_get_player_count" which can retrieve active players given game_title, year, optional platform. And "video_games_get_sales".

Thus we should call both functions twice each: once for 2019/PS, once for 2020/PC.

But note: The user wants comparison between those counts; so after retrieving values, compute difference or ratio maybe. Provide explanation.

We'll use the tool calls accordingly.

First get active players for 2019, Playstation.

Then get active players for 2020, PC.

Similarly sales for 2019, Playstation.

Sales for 2020, PC.

After obtaining results, produce answer comparing them.

Let's do first function call: video_games_get_player_count with game_title="Call of Duty: Modern Warfare", year=2019, platform="Playstation". Then second call: same but year=2020, platform="PC". Third: video_games_get_sales for 2019, Playstation. Fourth: video_games_get_sales for 2020, PC.

Proceed.
